description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the SocialMediaAuthenticationService in the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup procedures and multiple test methods that verify the functionality of social media (OpenID) authentication features, such as provider DAO retrieval, authentication initiation, redirection URL generation, user retrieval, and handling OpenID Connect (OIDC) authentication process.

classes.name: SocialMediaAuthenticationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the SocialMediaAuthenticationService regarding OpenID authentication workflows within the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including instantiating the SocialMediaAuthenticationService object and loading test fixture data.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderDao
methods.description: Verifies that the getAuthProviderDao() method returns an instance of AuthProviderDao.

methods.name: testInitiateAuthentication
methods.description: Tests the initiateAuthentication() method to ensure it returns a properly configured OIDC client with expected client secret, client ID, scopes, and redirect URL.

methods.name: testGetRedirectURL
methods.description: Checks that getRedirectURL() generates the correct redirect URL via mocked UrlGenerator.

methods.name: testGetScope
methods.description: Asserts that getScope() returns the expected scope string and is of type string.

methods.name: testGetUserForAuthenticate
methods.description: Tests retrieval of User entity based on provided username in UserCredential, verifying user ID and not deleted status.

methods.name: testSetOIDCUserIdentity
methods.description: Verifies that setOIDCUserIdentity() correctly associates a User with an OpenID provider, verifying user ID and provider name.

methods.name: testHandleOIDCAuthentication
methods.description: Simulates the process of handling OIDC authentication, mocking session interactions and verifying successful authentication handling.
